description: This file defines a class 'KeyManagementEventHooks' with static methods for handling key lifecycle events such as creation, update, rotation, and deletion. It includes logic for logging, email notifications, and secret management integration within a larger system.

classes.name: KeyManagementEventHooks
classes.description: A class providing static methods for handling key lifecycle events such as creation, update, rotation, and deletion, including logging, email notifications, and secret management.

methods.name: async_key_generated_hook
methods.description: Handles post-processing after a key is generated, including email notification, audit logging, and storing the key in secret manager.

methods.name: async_key_updated_hook
methods.description: Handles post-processing after a key is updated, including audit logging.

methods.name: async_key_rotated_hook
methods.description: Handles post-processing after a key is rotated, including secret rotation, email notification, and audit logging.

methods.name: async_key_deleted_hook
methods.description: Handles post-processing after keys are deleted, including audit logging and secret deletion.

methods.name: _store_virtual_key_in_secret_manager
methods.description: Stores a virtual key in the secret manager.

methods.name: _rotate_virtual_key_in_secret_manager
methods.description: Rotates a virtual key in the secret manager.

methods.name: _get_secret_name
methods.description: Constructs the full secret name with prefix for stored virtual keys.

methods.name: _delete_virtual_keys_from_secret_manager
methods.description: Deletes virtual keys from the secret manager.

methods.name: _get_secret_manager_optional_params
methods.description: Retrieves optional parameters for secret manager based on team ID.

methods.name: _is_email_sending_enabled
methods.description: Checks if email sending is enabled via enterprise loggers or alerting configuration.

methods.name: _send_key_created_email
methods.description: Sends an email notification when a key is created, if email is enabled.

methods.name: _send_key_rotated_email
methods.description: Sends an email notification when a key is rotated, if email is enabled.
